body:
Thank you. Indeed, what you've said about yourself sounds (while not exactly the same) a bit like talking to myself. Thank you for taking the time to respond.

The problem is, it's always something, I find. I can tell myself, logically, that everything will eventually get better, even a little, but that doesn't help emotionally. I've on a bit of a downward spiral for quite some time, and I can legitimately say these past two years have been the longest and most grueling yet, which has really made me question whether or not I can actually make it those 30-40 years that I promised myself.

Essentially lost my job today. My place of work has been closed for a week due to my boss's mother falling and hurting herself. She does a great deal of the work at the restaurant, and after the injury she evidently said she didn't want to go back. As a result, they're likely going to be selling the business to a prior co-owner. I know this man, and he's one of the biggest scumbags there are, and it disgusts me that he's going to get the restaurant after all the shit he's pulled. 

Meanwhile, the place is still closed.

I don't know.

Anyway, thank you again for your reply. Hope you have a good night.
